disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substance or alcoholic beverage to an extent that impairs ability to perform professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for offense reasonably related to qualifications, functions or duties, or involving fraud, dishonesty, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution under the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to this chapter, for any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty or an act of violence, or for any offense involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing license or obtaining permission to take examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate of registration or authority, permit or license issued pursuant to this chapter or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees by fraud, deception or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, misconduct, repeated negligence, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in performance of professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, misconduct, repeated negligence, gross negligence, fraud, misrepresentation or dishonesty in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or assisting any person to violate any provision of the chapter or lawful rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of this chapter, or of any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of licensed person or allowing another to use one's license or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her certificate of registration or authority, permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state, territory, federal agency or country on grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in Missouri
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by this chapter granted by another state, territory, federal agency or country upon grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Person finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling any person to practice without proper registration and eligibility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of license based upon a material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading or deceptive advertisement or solicitation

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot

methods_authorized.quote: diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot

drug_authority.value: Use of drugs and medicines in treatment of ailments of the human foot, excluding treatment of systemic diseases
drug_authority.quote: The use of such drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the term "human foot" includes the ankle and the tendons which insert into the foot as well as the foot

amputation_authorized.quote: with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: with the exception of administration of general anesthetics

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: For surgery of the ankle only, the doctor of podiatric medicine licensed pursuant to this chapter shall either be board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or shall complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: any newly licensed doctor of podiatric medicine desiring to perform ankle surgery and licensed pursuant to this chapter after January 1, 2005, shall be required to complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle by a doctor of podiatric medicine shall be performed only in a licensed acute care hospital or a licensed ambulatory surgical clinic.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: The use of such drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.

board_certification_body.quote: board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This chapter shall further not apply to manufacturers of and dealers in shoes or corrective appliances for deformed feet; provided, however, that such manufacturers and dealers shall not be entitled to practice podiatric medicine, as in this chapter defined, unless duly licensed so to do as herein provided.
